title: Life Framework storyboard (lf-storyboard/1)
description: One file a video is made from: tools/cli film-make video/<name>.json validates it, shoots each shot through the camera rig and scene presets, and post-produces the takes. tools/film/storyboard.mjs (validateStoryboard) is the check that names the wrong field; this file is the reference for editors. Unknown keys are kept and ignored (notes, issue links, blockedBy).

name.description: Names the takes folder agent-box/reports/film/<name>/ and the output mp4.

transition.description: Crossfade seconds between shots (default 0.6; every shot must be at least twice this long).

variants.description: Other renders of the same shots, such as the 9:16 short.

scenes.description: Scene presets a shot's `scene` names; hour and weather override the preset for this film. Light-only presets exist for the trailer locations (LF_FilmSceneEnv); `street` also spawns a walker and a car.

music.description: post.mjs music bed: file, gainDb, fadeIn, fadeOut.

voice.description: post.mjs voice: lengthScale (and speaker, for a multi-speaker model only).

group.description: Location group; `--group <name>` shoots all its shots.

duration.description: Seconds on screen; the camera move lasts exactly this long.

lines.description: A title shot: leading becomes the title card, trailing the end card.

setup.description: Harness commands sent to the shot's client before the take (stand, use, flow ...).

hud.description: Default off: HUD and hint pop-ups are hidden for the take.

captions.description: post.mjs cues: a file or [[from, to, text]].

vo.description: post.mjs voice-over: a file or [[at, text]].

pending.description: Why the shot cannot be shot yet; film-make skips it and says so.

client.description: firstPerson: the session client whose own view is recorded.

point.description: orbit: the point circled. follow: a point near the vehicle to follow.

azimuth.description: orbit: degrees of the arc centre; 0 = +z side, 90 = +x, 180 = -z, 270 = -x.

arc.description: orbit: degrees swept (default 140; negative sweeps the other way).

height.description: orbit: camera height above the point (default 5).

source.description: still: the gallery still (tools/cli shots ...) this shot uses; not shot by film-make.
